prompts.prompt: Wide photograph inside Kulturhuset Stadsteatern's bright workshop room, tall windows casting soft daylight across long wooden tables where a dozen adults sit sewing patches onto worn denim jackets, surrounded by colorful fabric scraps, thread spools, and needle-felted cushions.

Medium shot of young dancers in a sunlit Stockholm dance studio with pale wooden floors and tall mirrors, a choreographer in loose black clothing demonstrating a movement while teenage participants mirror the gesture with focused, intent expressions.

Environmental portrait inside Dramatenbaren, warm pendant lights glowing above a small group of adults standing in a loose circle, one person holding an open book while others listen attentively in the dim theatrical lounge with velvet seating in the background.

Close-up of weathered hands folding patterned washi paper into a traditional Japanese accordion binding on a worn wooden table, soft natural light from an Etnografiska museet window illuminating the delicate creases and muted floral designs of the sheets.
